<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Eazy Request</title>
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Serif:wght@500;600&family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500;600&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap');
:root, body {
--ink: #16223B;
--paper: #EFF1EC;
--paper-raised: #FFFFFF;
--rule: #D3D6CD;
--brass: #A6803D;
--brass-dark: #8A6A30;
--forest: #2F6E4F;
--rust: #A43F2D;
--amber: #B5791F;
--slate-mid: #5B6472;
--brand-red: #B23A2E;
--brand-red-dark: #7A2620;
--font-serif: 'IBM Plex Serif', Georgia, serif;
--font-sans: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, sans-serif;
--font-mono: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;
}
html, body {
margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: var(--font-sans); color: var(--ink);
background: var(--paper); min-height: 100vh; width: 100%;
}
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
.mono { font-family: var(--font-mono); }
button, input, textarea { font-family: inherit; }
/* Login */
.login-shell { display: flex; min-height: 100vh; }
.login-left {
flex: 1.1; position: relative; overflow: hidden;
background: linear-gradient(150deg, var(--ink) 0%, var(--ink) 55%, var(--brand-red-dark) 130%);
color: #EDE9DD; padding: 56px 48px;
display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 18px; justify-content: center;
}
.login-left::before {
content: ""; position: absolute; right: -120px; bottom: -140px; width: 360px; height: 360px;
border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(178,58,46,.45) 0%, rgba(178,58,46,0) 70%);
}
.login-left > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.brand-seal {
width: 84px; height: 84px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid var(--brand-red);
display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 2px;
color: #E8AFA6; font-family: var(--font-mono); transform: rotate(-6deg);
}
.brand-seal span:first-child { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .06em; color: #F1DAD6; }
.brand-seal span:last-child { font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .12em; }
.brand-rule { width: 46px; height: 3px; background: var(--brand-red); margin: 4px 0 2px; }
.login-title { font-family: var(--font-serif); font-size: 34px; margin: 6px 0 0; font-weight: 600; }
.login-title em { color: #E8AFA6; font-style: normal; }
.login-sub { color: #B9C0CE; max-width: 340px; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0; }
.login-right { flex: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 32px; }
.login-card {
background: var(--paper-raised); border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-top: 3px solid var(--brand-red); padding: 36px;
width: 100%; max-width: 360px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px;
}
.login-card h2 { font-family: var(--font-serif); margin: 0 0 14px; font-size: 20px; }
.login-card .form-tab.active { border-bottom-color: var(--brand-red); }
.login-card .btn-primary {
background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--brand-red), var(--brand-red-dark));
letter-spacing: .03em;
}
.login-card .btn-primary:hover { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #C24537, var(--brand-red-dark)); }
.demo-accounts { margin-top: 16px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--slate-mid); }
.demo-accounts summary { cursor: pointer; color: var(--brass-dark); }
.demo-accounts ul { margin: 8px 0 0; padding-left: 16px; line-height: 1.8; }
/* Inputs */
.field-label { font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; color: var(--slate-mid); display:block; margin: 14px 0 6px; }
.text-input {
border: 1px solid var(--rule); background: var(--paper-raised); padding: 10px 12px;
font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink); width: 100%;
}
.text-input:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--brass); outline-offset: 1px; }
.textarea { resize: vertical; line-height: 1.5; }
.form-error {
display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: var(--rust); font-size: 13px; margin-top: 10px;
}
.form-error:empty { display: none; margin: 0; }
/* Buttons */
.btn-primary {
background: var(--ink); color: #F3F1EA; border: none; padding: 10px 18px;
font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; letter-spacing: .02em;
}
.btn-primary:hover { background: #223255; }
.btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: default; }
.btn-secondary {
background: transparent; color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--rule); padding: 10px 18px;
font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer;
}
.btn-danger {
background: transparent; color: var(--rust); border: 1px solid var(--rust); padding: 10px 18px;
font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
}
.btn-return {
background: transparent; color: var(--amber); border: 1px solid var(--amber); padding: 10px 18px;
font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
}
.btn-approve {
background: var(--forest); color: #fff; border: none; padding: 10px 18px;
font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
}
.btn-approve:hover { background: #285C42; }
.btn-danger:disabled, .btn-return:disabled, .btn-approve:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: default; }
.return-callout {
display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: flex-start; background: #FBF3E2; border: 1px solid var(--amber);
color: #6E4E13; padding: 12px 14px; margin-top: 14px; font-size: 13px;
}
.return-callout-title { font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 2px; }
.return-callout-note { font-style: italic; }
.link-btn {
background: none; border: none; color: var(--brass-dark); font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer;
display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 0;
}
/* App shell */
.app-shell { display: flex; min-height: 100vh; }
.sidebar {
width: 240px; background: var(--ink); color: #E7E5DA; flex-shrink: 0;
display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 20px 14px;
}
.sidebar-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 4px 6px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid #2A3958; }
.seal-emoji { font-size: 30px; line-height: 1; }
.brand-title { font-family: var(--font-serif); font-size: 16px; }
.brand-sub { font-size: 11px; color: #98A2B8; }
.sidebar-user { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 16px 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid #2A3958; }
.user-avatar {
width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 50%; background: #223255;
display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; font-size: 15px;
}
.user-name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; }
.user-dept { font-size: 11px; color: #98A2B8; }
.sidebar-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding-top: 14px; flex: 1; }
.nav-item {
display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: none; border: none; color: #C8CCD8;
font-size: 13px; padding: 9px 8px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; width: 100%;
}
.nav-item:hover { background: #1F2C48; color: #fff; }
.nav-item.active { background: #223255; color: #fff; border-left: 2px solid var(--brass); padding-left: 6px; }
.nav-item.logout { color: #98A2B8; margin-top: 10px; }
.main-area { flex: 1; padding: 32px 40px; overflow-y: auto; }
/* Panel */
.panel { background: var(--paper-raised); border: 1px solid var(--rule); max-width: 980px; }
.panel-header {
display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 20px 26px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.panel-header h2 { font-family: var(--font-serif); font-size: 19px; margin: 0; flex: 1; }
.dept-chip, .type-chip {
font-size: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--rule); padding: 4px 9px; display: inline-flex;
align-items: center; gap: 5px; color: var(--slate-mid);
}
.form-body { padding: 22px 26px 26px; }
.panel-footer {
display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 10px; padding: 18px 26px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
}
.hint { color: var(--slate-mid); font-size: 13px; }
/* Form tabs */
.form-tabs { display: flex; gap: 2px; padding: 14px 26px 0; }
.form-tab {
background: none; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: var(--slate-mid);
font-size: 13px; padding: 8px 4px; margin-right: 22px; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
}
.form-tab.active { color: var(--ink); border-bottom-color: var(--brass); font-weight: 500; }
.form-tab-panel { display: none; }
.form-tab-panel.active { display: block; }
/* Quotations */
.quote-grid { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; margin-top: 12px; }
.quote-slot { border: 1px dashed var(--rule); padding: 12px; }
.quote-slot-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 12px; color: var(--slate-mid); margin-bottom: 8px; }
.quote-drop {
display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 18px;
color: var(--brass-dark); cursor: pointer; font-size: 13px;
}
.quote-file {
display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 13px; padding: 6px 4px; color: var(--ink);
}
.quote-file-link { text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid var(--rule); padding: 10px; display: flex; }
.quote-file-name { flex: 1; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.quote-file-size { color: var(--slate-mid); font-size: 12px; }
/* List */
.search-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--rule); padding: 8px 10px; margin-bottom: 14px; color: var(--slate-mid); }
.search-input { border: none; outline: none; font-size: 13px; flex: 1; font-family: var(--font-sans); background: transparent; }
.req-table { display: flex; flex-direction: column; border: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.req-row {
display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 2.2fr 1.4fr .9fr 1fr .9fr 1.6fr;
gap: 8px; align-items: center; padding: 11px 12px; font-size: 13px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
background: none; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; color: var(--ink); width: 100%;
}
.req-row span { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; }
.req-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.req-row:not(.req-row-head):not(.req-row-empty):hover { background: var(--paper); }
.req-row-head { font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; color: var(--slate-mid); cursor: default; }
.req-row-empty { padding: 20px; color: var(--slate-mid); font-size: 13px; }
.req-title { font-weight: 500; }
.status-cell { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 4px; }
.sla-badge {
display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--slate-mid);
font-family: var(--font-mono);
}
.sla-badge.sla-overdue { color: var(--rust); font-weight: 500; }
.empty-state { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 60px 20px; color: var(--slate-mid); text-align: center; }
.empty-state .glyph { font-size: 28px; }
/* Detail */
.detail-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr; gap: 0; }
.detail-main { padding: 22px 26px; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.detail-side { padding: 22px 26px; }
.detail-title-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.detail-title-row h1 { font-family: var(--font-serif); font-size: 22px; margin: 6px 0 0; }
.meta-row { display: flex; gap: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; color: var(--slate-mid); font-size: 12px; margin: 12px 0 6px; }
.meta-row span { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; }
.section-label { font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; color: var(--slate-mid); margin: 22px 0 8px; }
.description-text { line-height: 1.6; font-size: 14px; white-space: pre-wrap; }
.decision-box { margin-top: 26px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); padding-top: 18px; }
.decision-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 10px; margin-top: 10px; }
.timeline { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; }
.timeline li { display: flex; gap: 10px; }
.timeline li .tl-icon { margin-top: 3px; color: var(--brass); flex-shrink: 0; font-size: 12px; }
.timeline-action { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; }
.timeline-meta { font-size: 11px; color: var(--slate-mid); }
.timeline-note { font-size: 12px; color: var(--slate-mid); font-style: italic; margin-top: 3px; }
/* Stamp */
.stamp {
display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10.5px;
letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--stamp-color);
border: 1.5px solid var(--stamp-color); padding: 4px 9px; border-radius: 3px;
transform: rotate(-1.5deg); white-space: nowrap;
}
.storage-note { font-size: 11px; color: var(--slate-mid); padding: 10px 14px; border-top: 1px solid #2A3958; margin-top: 10px; }
/* Reports */
.report-stats { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 18px 26px 4px; }
.report-stat { border: 1px solid var(--rule); padding: 10px 14px; min-width: 110px; text-align: center; }
.report-stat-num { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; }
.report-stat-label { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--slate-mid); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .03em; margin-top: 2px; }
.report-meta { margin: 0 26px 8px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--slate-mid); }
@media print {
body { background: #fff; }
.sidebar, .no-print, .panel-footer, .decision-box { display: none !important; }
.app-shell { display: block; }
.main-area { padding: 0; }
.panel { border: none; max-width: none; }
.req-row { break-inside: avoid; }
}
@media (max-width: 900px) {
.login-shell { flex-direction: column; }
.app-shell { flex-direction: column; }
.sidebar { width: 100%; flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.sidebar-nav { flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.detail-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
.detail-main { border-right: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.req-row, .req-row-head { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
.main-area { padding: 18px; }
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="app"></div>
<script>
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Reference data */
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
const DEPARTMENTS = [
{ key: "transport", label: "Transport", glyph: "🚚" },
{ key: "operations", label: "Operations", glyph: "⚙️" },
{ key: "support", label: "Customer Support", glyph: "🎧" },
{ key: "hc", label: "Human Capital", glyph: "🧑‍🤝‍🧑" },
{ key: "sales", label: "Sales", glyph: "📈" },
{ key: "security", label: "Security", glyph: "🛡️" },
{ key: "it", label: "IT Support", glyph: "🖥️" },
{ key: "finance", label: "Finance", glyph: "🏛️" },
];
const MANAGER_USER = { username: "manager", password: "manager", name: "Managing Director",
department: null, departmentLabel: "Executive Office", role: "manager" };
function loadUsers() {
try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("req-users") || "[]"); }
catch { return []; }
}
function saveUsers(list) { localStorage.setItem("req-users", JSON.stringify(list)); }
function allUsers() { return [...loadUsers(), MANAGER_USER]; }
const deptMeta = key => DEPARTMENTS.find(d => d.key === key);
const STATUS_META = {
pending_finance: { label: "Pending · Finance Review", color: "var(--amber)" },
pending_manager: { label: "Pending · Final Approval", color: "var(--amber)" },
returned: { label: "Returned · Needs Revision", color: "var(--amber)" },
approved: { label: "Approved", color: "var(--forest)" },
rejected: { label: "Rejected", color: "var(--rust)" },
};
// Kept conservative because localStorage's total quota (~5-10MB per
// browser) is much smaller than a real file store.
const MAX_FILE_BYTES = 700_000;
const SLA_HOURS = 12;
const STAGE_LABEL = { pending_finance: "Finance review", pending_manager: "Final approval" };
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Storage helpers (localStorage — data stays in THIS browser only) */
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
function loadIndex() {
try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("req-index") || "[]"); }
catch { return []; }
}
function saveIndex(list) { localStorage.setItem("req-index", JSON.stringify(list)); }
function loadDetail(id) {
const raw = localStorage.getItem(`req-detail:${id}`);
return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
}
function saveDetail(id, record) { localStorage.setItem(`req-detail:${id}`, JSON.stringify(record)); }
function loadCounters() {
try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("req-counters") || "{}"); }
catch { return {}; }
}
function saveCounters(c) { localStorage.setItem("req-counters", JSON.stringify(c)); }
function reserveDocumentNumber(type, index) {
const prefix = type === "Payment" ? "PR" : "PO";
const year = new Date().getFullYear();
const counters = loadCounters();
const key = `${prefix}-${year}`;
let seq = (counters[key] || 0) + 1;
let id = `${prefix}-${year}-${String(seq).padStart(4, "0")}`;
const existing = new Set(index.map(r => r.id));
while (existing.has(id)) { seq += 1; id = `${prefix}-${year}-${String(seq).padStart(4, "0")}`; }
counters[key] = seq;
saveCounters(counters);
return id;
}
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Small helpers */
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
function nowIso() { return new Date().toISOString(); }
function fmtDate(iso) {
return new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString(undefined, { day: "2-digit", month: "short", year: "numeric" });
}
function fmtMoney(v) {
if (v === "" || v === null || v === undefined) return "—";
const n = Number(v);
if (Number.isNaN(n)) return v;
return n.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
}
function escapeHtml(str) {
return String(str ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c]));
}
function slaInfo(status, updatedAt, now) {
if (!STAGE_LABEL[status]) return null;
const deadline = new Date(updatedAt).getTime() + SLA_HOURS * 3600000;
const diffMs = deadline - now;
const overdue = diffMs < 0;
const absMs = Math.abs(diffMs);
const hours = absMs / 3600000;
const text = hours < 1 ? `${Math.max(1, Math.round(absMs / 60000))}m` : `${hours.toFixed(1)}h`;
return { overdue, text, stage: STAGE_LABEL[status] };
}
function slaBadgeHTML(record) {
const info = slaInfo(record.status, record.updatedAt, Date.now());
if (!info) return "";
return `<span class="sla-badge${info.overdue ? " sla-overdue" : ""}" data-status="${record.status}" data-updated="${record.updatedAt}">
⏱ ${info.overdue ? "Overdue " + info.text : info.text + " left"} · ${info.stage}
</span>`;
}
function stampHTML(status) {
const meta = STATUS_META[status] || { label: status, color: "var(--slate-mid)" };
return `<span class="stamp" style="--stamp-color:${meta.color}">${meta.label}</span>`;
}
function deptGlyph(key) { const m = deptMeta(key); return m ? m.glyph : "🏛️"; }
function tickSlaBadges() {
document.querySelectorAll(".sla-badge").forEach(el => {
const info = slaInfo(el.dataset.status, el.dataset.updated, Date.now());
if (!info) { el.remove(); return; }
el.classList.toggle("sla-overdue", info.overdue);
el.textContent = `⏱ ${info.overdue ? "Overdue " + info.text : info.text + " left"} · ${info.stage}`;
});
}
setInterval(tickSlaBadges, 30000);
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Global state */
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
let currentUser = null;
let currentTab = null;
let currentScreen = null; // null | 'new-form'
let newFormType = null; // 'Payment' | 'Purchase Order'
let currentSelectedId = null;
let currentEditing = false;
let newFormQuotations = [null, null, null];
let reviseFormQuotations = [null, null, null];
const app = document.getElementById("app");
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Login screen */
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
function renderLogin(activeLoginTab) {
const tab = activeLoginTab || "signin";
app.innerHTML = `
<div class="login-shell">
<div class="login-left">
<div class="brand-seal"><span>EAZY</span><span>REQUEST</span></div>
<div class="brand-rule"></div>
<h1 class="login-title">Eazy <em>Request</em></h1>
<p class="login-sub">Payment &amp; Purchase Order requisitions, logged and reviewed in one place.</p>
</div>
<div class="login-right">
<div class="login-card">
<div class="form-tabs" style="padding:0 0 4px;">
<button class="form-tab${tab === "signin" ? " active" : ""}" data-action="login-tab" data-target="signin">Sign in</button>
<button class="form-tab${tab === "register" ? " active" : ""}" data-action="login-tab" data-target="register">Register (HODs)</button>
</div>
<form id="login-form" class="form-tab-panel${tab === "signin" ? " active" : ""}" data-panel="signin" style="padding-top:10px;">
<label class="field-label">Username</label>
<input class="text-input" id="login-username" placeholder="your username" autocomplete="off">
<label class="field-label">Password</label>
<input class="text-input" id="login-password" type="password" placeholder="password">
<div class="form-error" id="login-error"></div>
<button class="btn-primary" type="submit" style="width:100%;margin-top:8px;">Sign in</button>
<details class="demo-accounts">
<summary>Managing Director demo login</summary>
<ul><li><code>manager</code> / <code>manager</code> — Managing Director</li></ul>
</details>
</form>
<form id="register-form" class="form-tab-panel${tab === "register" ? " active" : ""}" data-panel="register" style="padding-top:10px;">
<p class="hint" style="margin:0 0 6px;">Heads of department: create your own login. One account per person — you'll pick which department you represent.</p>
<label class="field-label">Your name</label>
<input class="text-input" id="reg-name" placeholder="e.g. Naledi Kgosi">
<label class="field-label">Department</label>
<select class="text-input" id="reg-department">
<option value="">Select a department…</option>
${DEPARTMENTS.map(d => `<option value="${d.key}">${d.glyph} ${escapeHtml(d.label)}</option>`).join("")}
</select>
<label class="field-label">Choose a username</label>
<input class="text-input" id="reg-username" placeholder="e.g. n.kgosi" autocomplete="off">
<label class="field-label">Choose a password</label>
<input class="text-input" id="reg-password" type="password" placeholder="At least 4 characters">
<label class="field-label">Confirm password</label>
<input class="text-input" id="reg-password2" type="password" placeholder="Re-enter password">
<div class="form-error" id="register-error"></div>
<button class="btn-primary" type="submit" style="width:100%;margin-top:8px;">Create account &amp; sign in</button>
</form>
</div>
</div>
</div>`;
const focusEl = document.getElementById(tab === "signin" ? "login-username" : "reg-name");
if (focusEl) focusEl.focus();
}
function handleLoginSubmit() {
const username = document.getElementById("login-username").value.trim().toLowerCase();
const password = document.getElementById("login-password").value;
const user = allUsers().find(u => u.username === username && u.password === password);
if (!user) {
document.getElementById("login-error").innerHTML = `⚠️ Username or password not recognised.`;
return;
}
currentUser = user;
currentTab = user.role === "manager" ? "approve" : user.role === "finance" ? "review" : "mine";
currentScreen = null; currentSelectedId = null; currentEditing = false;
renderApp();
}
function handleRegisterSubmit() {
const name = document.getElementById("reg-name").value.trim();
const deptKey = document.getElementById("reg-department").value;
const username = document.getElementById("reg-username").value.trim().toLowerCase();
const password = document.getElementById("reg-password").value;
const password2 = document.getElementById("reg-password2").value;
const errEl = document.getElementById("register-error");
errEl.textContent = "";
if (!name) { errEl.textContent = "Please enter your name."; return; }
const dept = deptMeta(deptKey);
if (!dept) { errEl.textContent = "Please select your department."; return; }
if (!/^[a-z0-9._-]{3,24}$/.test(username)) {
errEl.textContent = "Username must be 3-24 characters: letters, numbers, dots, underscores or hyphens only.";
return;
}
if (password.length < 4) { errEl.textContent = "Password must be at least 4 characters."; return; }
if (password !== password2) { errEl.textContent = "Passwords don't match."; return; }
if (allUsers().some(u => u.username === username)) {
errEl.textContent = "That username is already taken — please choose another.";
return;
}
const newUser = {
username, password, name,
department: dept.key, departmentLabel: dept.label,
role: dept.key === "finance" ? "finance" : "head",
};
const users = loadUsers();
users.push(newUser);
saveUsers(users);
currentUser = newUser;
currentTab = newUser.role === "finance" ? "review" : "mine";
currentScreen = null; currentSelectedId = null; currentEditing = false;
renderApp();
}
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* App shell (sidebar + main) */
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
function sidebarItems(user) {
const items = [];
if (user.role === "head" || user.role === "finance") {
items.push({ key: "new-payment", label: "New Payment Requisition", glyph: "➕", nav: false });
items.push({ key: "new-po", label: "New PO Requisition", glyph: "➕", nav: false });
items.push({ key: "mine", label: "My Requisitions", glyph: "📋", nav: true });
}
if (user.role === "finance") {
items.push({ key: "review", label: "Finance Review Queue", glyph: "📥", nav: true });
items.push({ key: "approved", label: "Approved by Manager", glyph: "✅", nav: true });
items.push({ key: "all", label: "All Requisitions", glyph: "🗂️", nav: true });
}
if (user.role === "manager") {
items.push({ key: "approve", label: "Final Approval Queue", glyph: "🖋️", nav: true });
items.push({ key: "all", label: "All Requisitions", glyph: "🗂️", nav: true });
}
items.push({ key: "reports", label: "Reports", glyph: "📊", nav: true });
return items;
}
function renderApp() {
const user = currentUser;
const items = sidebarItems(user);
const activeKey = currentScreen === "new-form"
? (newFormType === "Payment" ? "new-payment" : "new-po")
: currentTab;
app.innerHTML = `
<div class="app-shell">
<aside class="sidebar">
<div class="sidebar-brand">
<span class="seal-emoji">🖋️</span>
<div><div class="brand-title">Eazy Request</div><div class="brand-sub">Payments &amp; POs</div></div>
</div>
<div class="sidebar-user">
<div class="user-avatar">${user.role === "manager" ? "👑" : deptGlyph(user.department)}</div>
<div><div class="user-name">${escapeHtml(user.name)}</div><div class="user-dept">${escapeHtml(user.departmentLabel)}</div></div>
</div>
<nav class="sidebar-nav">
${items.map(it => `
<button class="nav-item${activeKey === it.key ? " active" : ""}" data-action="${it.nav ? "nav-tab" : "new-form"}"
data-tab="${it.key}" data-type="${it.key === "new-payment" ? "Payment" : it.key === "new-po" ? "Purchase Order" : ""}">
<span>${it.glyph}</span>${it.label}
</button>`).join("")}
</nav>
<button class="nav-item logout" data-action="logout"><span>🚪</span>Sign out</button>
<div class="storage-note">Data is stored in this browser only (localStorage) — it won't sync with other computers.</div>
</aside>
<main class="main-area" id="main-content"></main>
</div>`;
renderMain();
}
function renderMain() {
const main = document.getElementById("main-content");
const index = loadIndex();
if (currentSelectedId) { renderDetailScreen(main, currentSelectedId); return; }
if (currentScreen === "new-form") { renderNewForm(main); return; }
const user = currentUser;
if (currentTab === "mine") {
const mine = index.filter(r => r.department === user.department);
main.innerHTML = panelHTML("My Requisitions — " + escapeHtml(user.departmentLabel), listHTML(mine, "📋", "No requisitions filed yet. Use the sidebar to file a new one."));
} else if (currentTab === "review") {
const q = index.filter(r => r.status === "pending_finance" && r.department !== "finance");
main.innerHTML = panelHTML("Finance Review Queue", listHTML(q, "📥", "Nothing waiting on Finance review right now."));
} else if (currentTab === "approve") {
const q = index.filter(r => r.status === "pending_manager");
main.innerHTML = panelHTML("Final Approval Queue", listHTML(q, "🖋️", "Nothing waiting on final approval right now."));
} else if (currentTab === "approved") {
const q = index.filter(r => r.status === "approved").sort((a, b) => new Date(b.updatedAt) - new Date(a.updatedAt));
main.innerHTML = panelHTML("Approved by Manager", listHTML(q, "✅", "Nothing has received final approval yet."));
} else if (currentTab === "all") {
main.innerHTML = panelHTML("All Requisitions", listHTML(index, "🗂️", "No requisitions have been filed yet."));
} else if (currentTab === "reports") {
main.innerHTML = reportsFilterHTML(user);
generateReport();
return;
}
bindSearchFilter();
}
function panelHTML(title, bodyHTML) {
return `<div class="panel"><div class="panel-header"><h2>${title}</h2></div><div class="form-body">${bodyHTML}</div></div>`;
}
function listHTML(items, glyph, emptyText) {
if (items.length === 0) {
return `<div class="empty-state"><div class="glyph">${glyph}</div><p>${escapeHtml(emptyText)}</p></div>`;
}
const rows = items.map(it => `
<button class="req-row" data-action="open-detail" data-id="${it.id}">
<span class="mono">${it.id}</span>
<span class="req-title">${escapeHtml(it.title)}</span>
<span>${deptGlyph(it.department)} ${escapeHtml(it.departmentLabel)}</span>
<span>${escapeHtml(it.type)}</span>
<span class="mono">${fmtMoney(it.amount)}</span>
<span>${fmtDate(it.createdAt)}</span>
<span class="status-cell">${stampHTML(it.status)}${slaBadgeHTML(it)}</span>
</button>`).join("");
return `
<div class="search-row">🔍<input class="search-input" id="search-input" placeholder="Search by title, department, or ID…"></div>
<div class="req-table">
<div class="req-row req-row-head"><span>ID</span><span>Title</span><span>Department</span><span>Type</span><span>Amount</span><span>Filed</span><span>Status</span></div>
<div id="req-rows">${rows}</div>
<div class="req-row-empty" id="req-empty" style="display:none;">No matches.</div>
</div>`;
}
function bindSearchFilter() {
const input = document.getElementById("search-input");
if (!input) return;
input.addEventListener("input", () => {
const q = input.value.toLowerCase();
const rows = document.querySelectorAll("#req-rows .req-row");
let visible = 0;
rows.forEach(row => {
const match = row.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(q);
row.style.display = match ? "" : "none";
if (match) visible++;
});
const empty = document.getElementById("req-empty");
if (empty) empty.style.display = visible === 0 ? "" : "none";
});
}
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Reports */
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
function reportsFilterHTML(user) {
const today = new Date();
const toStr = today.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
const fromStr = new Date(today.getTime() - 29 * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
const deptField = user.role !== "head" ? `
<div style="flex:1; min-width:160px;">
<label class="field-label">Department</label>
<select class="text-input" id="rep-dept">
<option value="all">All departments</option>
${DEPARTMENTS.map(d => `<option value="${d.key}">${d.glyph} ${escapeHtml(d.label)}</option>`).join("")}
</select>
</div>` : "";
return `
<div class="panel">
<div class="panel-header"><h2>Requisition Report</h2></div>
<div class="form-body no-print">
<div style="display:flex; gap:16px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
<div style="flex:1; min-width:150px;">
<label class="field-label">From</label>
<input type="date" class="text-input" id="rep-from" value="${fromStr}">
</div>
<div style="flex:1; min-width:150px;">
<label class="field-label">To</label>
<input type="date" class="text-input" id="rep-to" value="${toStr}">
</div>
${deptField}
<div style="flex:1; min-width:150px;">
<label class="field-label">Type</label>
<select class="text-input" id="rep-type">
<option value="all">All types</option>
<option value="Payment">Payment</option>
<option value="Purchase Order">Purchase Order</option>
</select>
</div>
<div style="flex:1; min-width:150px;">
<label class="field-label">Status</label>
<select class="text-input" id="rep-status">
<option value="all">All statuses</option>
${Object.keys(STATUS_META).map(s => `<option value="${s}">${STATUS_META[s].label}</option>`).join("")}
</select>
</div>
</div>
<div style="display:flex; gap:10px; margin-top:16px;">
<button class="btn-primary" data-action="generate-report">Generate Report</button>
<button class="btn-secondary" data-action="print-report">🖨 Print / Save as PDF</button>
</div>
<div class="form-error" id="report-error"></div>
</div>
<div id="report-results"></div>
</div>`;
}
function computeReportScope(user) {
const index = loadIndex();
return user.role === "head" ? index.filter(r => r.department === user.department) : index;
}
function generateReport() {
const fromVal = document.getElementById("rep-from").value;
const toVal = document.getElementById("rep-to").value;
const deptEl = document.getElementById("rep-dept");
const deptVal = deptEl ? deptEl.value : "all";
const typeVal = document.getElementById("rep-type").value;
const statusVal = document.getElementById("rep-status").value;
const errorEl = document.getElementById("report-error");
const resultsEl = document.getElementById("report-results");
errorEl.textContent = "";
if (!fromVal || !toVal) { errorEl.textContent = "Please choose both a start and end date."; return; }
const fromDate = new Date(fromVal + "T00:00:00");
const toDate = new Date(toVal + "T23:59:59");
if (fromDate > toDate) { errorEl.textContent = 'The "From" date must be before the "To" date.'; return; }
let scope = computeReportScope(currentUser);
if (deptVal && deptVal !== "all") scope = scope.filter(r => r.department === deptVal);
if (typeVal !== "all") scope = scope.filter(r => r.type === typeVal);
if (statusVal !== "all") scope = scope.filter(r => r.status === statusVal);
scope = scope.filter(r => { const d = new Date(r.createdAt); return d >= fromDate && d <= toDate; });
scope.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt) - new Date(a.createdAt));
const statusCounts = {};
Object.keys(STATUS_META).forEach(s => (statusCounts[s] = 0));
let totalAmount = 0, amountCount = 0;
scope.forEach(r => {
statusCounts[r.status] = (statusCounts[r.status] || 0) + 1;
const n = Number(r.amount);
if (r.amount && !Number.isNaN(n)) { totalAmount += n; amountCount++; }
});
const statCardsHTML = `
<div class="report-stats">
<div class="report-stat"><div class="report-stat-num">${scope.length}</div><div class="report-stat-label">Total requisitions</div></div>
${Object.keys(STATUS_META).map(s => `
<div class="report-stat"><div class="report-stat-num" style="color:${STATUS_META[s].color}">${statusCounts[s]}</div><div class="report-stat-label">${STATUS_META[s].label}</div></div>
`).join("")}
<div class="report-stat"><div class="report-stat-num mono">${amountCount > 0 ? fmtMoney(totalAmount) : "—"}</div><div class="report-stat-label">Total est. amount${amountCount < scope.length ? " (where provided)" : ""}</div></div>
</div>`;
resultsEl.innerHTML = `
<div id="report-printable">
<div class="report-meta">${escapeHtml(currentUser.name)} (${escapeHtml(currentUser.departmentLabel)}) · ${fmtDate(fromDate.toISOString())} – ${fmtDate(toDate.toISOString())} · generated ${fmtDate(nowIso())}</div>
${statCardsHTML}
<div class="form-body" style="padding-top:6px;">
${listHTML(scope, "📊", "No requisitions match these filters.")}
</div>
</div>`;
bindSearchFilter();
}
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Quotation upload slot */
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
function quoteSlotHTML(idx, file, formName) {
if (file) {
return `<div class="quote-slot" id="${formName}-slot-${idx}">
<div class="quote-slot-head"><span>Quotation ${idx + 1}</span>
<button type="button" class="link-btn" data-action="remove-quote" data-form="${formName}" data-idx="${idx}">🗑 Remove</button></div>
<div class="quote-file">📎<span class="quote-file-name">${escapeHtml(file.name)}</span><span class="quote-file-size">${(file.size / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB</span></div>
</div>`;
}
return `<div class="quote-slot" id="${formName}-slot-${idx}">
<div class="quote-slot-head"><span>Quotation ${idx + 1}</span></div>
<label class="quote-drop">⬆️<span>Upload quotation ${idx + 1}</span>
<input type="file" accept="image/*,.pdf" style="display:none" data-quote-idx="${idx}" data-form="${formName}">
</label>
</div>`;
}
function quoteGridHTML(formName, quotations) {
return `<div class="quote-grid">${[0, 1, 2].map(i => quoteSlotHTML(i, quotations[i], formName)).join("")}</div>`;
}
function updateQuoteCountLabel(formName) {
const arr = formName === "new" ? newFormQuotations : reviseFormQuotations;
const count = arr.filter(Boolean).length;
const label = document.getElementById(`${formName}-quote-count`);
if (label) label.textContent = `Quotations (${count}/3)`;
}

function renderNewForm(main) {
newFormQuotations = [null, null, null];
const type = newFormType;
main.innerHTML = `
<div class="panel">
<div class="panel-header">
<button class="link-btn" data-action="back-to-list">‹ Back</button>
<h2>New ${escapeHtml(type)} Requisition</h2>
<span class="dept-chip">${deptGlyph(currentUser.department)} ${escapeHtml(currentUser.departmentLabel)}</span>
</div>
<div class="form-tabs">
<button class="form-tab active" data-action="form-tab" data-form="new" data-target="details">📄 Request Details</button>
<button class="form-tab" data-action="form-tab" data-form="new" data-target="quotations">📎 <span id="new-quote-count">Quotations (0/3)</span></button>
</div>
<div class="form-tab-panel active" data-form="new" data-panel="details">
<div class="form-body">
<label class="field-label">Title of request</label>
<input class="text-input" id="nf-title" placeholder="${type === "Payment" ? "e.g. Settlement of Q3 courier invoice" : "e.g. Replacement laptops for field team"}">
<label class="field-label">Short description</label>
<textarea class="text-input textarea" id="nf-description" rows="6" placeholder="Explain what this request is for, and why it's needed."></textarea>
<label class="field-label">Estimated amount (optional)</label>
<input class="text-input" id="nf-amount" placeholder="0.00">
</div>
</div>
<div class="form-tab-panel" data-form="new" data-panel="quotations">
<div class="form-body">
<p class="hint">Attach up to three supplier quotations to support this request. Max ${(MAX_FILE_BYTES/1024).toFixed(0)}KB each.</p>
${quoteGridHTML("new", newFormQuotations)}
</div>
</div>
<div class="form-error" id="nf-error" style="margin:0 26px;"></div>
<div class="panel-footer">
<button class="btn-secondary" data-action="back-to-list">Cancel</button>
<button class="btn-primary" data-action="submit-new">File Requisition</button>
</div>
</div>`;
}
function submitNewRequisition() {
const title = document.getElementById("nf-title").value.trim();
const description = document.getElementById("nf-description").value.trim();
const amount = document.getElementById("nf-amount").value.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, "");
const errorEl = document.getElementById("nf-error");
errorEl.textContent = "";
if (!title) { errorEl.textContent = "Please enter a title for this request."; switchFormTab("new", "details"); return; }
if (!description) { errorEl.textContent = "Please add a short description of the request."; switchFormTab("new", "details"); return; }
const attached = newFormQuotations.filter(Boolean);
if (attached.length < 3 && !confirm(`Only ${attached.length} of 3 quotations attached. Submit anyway?`)) {
switchFormTab("new", "quotations"); return;
}
try {
const index = loadIndex();
const id = reserveDocumentNumber(newFormType, index);
const initialStatus = currentUser.department === "finance" ? "pending_manager" : "pending_finance";
const record = {
id, type: newFormType, department: currentUser.department, departmentLabel: currentUser.departmentLabel,
title, description, amount, requestedBy: currentUser.name, quotations: attached,
status: initialStatus, createdAt: nowIso(), updatedAt: nowIso(),
history: [
{ ts: nowIso(), actor: currentUser.name, action: "Submitted", note: "" },
...(initialStatus === "pending_manager" && currentUser.department === "finance"
? [{ ts: nowIso(), actor: "System", action: "Routed directly to final approval (Finance-originated request)", note: "" }] : []),
],
};
saveDetail(id, record);
const summary = { id, type: newFormType, department: currentUser.department, departmentLabel: currentUser.departmentLabel,
title, requestedBy: currentUser.name, amount, status: initialStatus, createdAt: record.createdAt, updatedAt: record.updatedAt };
saveIndex([summary, ...index]);
currentScreen = null; currentTab = "mine"; currentSelectedId = id;
renderApp();
} catch (e) {
errorEl.textContent = "Could not save this requisition — your browser's storage may be full. Try smaller quotation files.";
}
}
function switchFormTab(formName, target) {
document.querySelectorAll(`.form-tab[data-form="${formName}"]`).forEach(b => b.classList.toggle("active", b.dataset.target === target));
document.querySelectorAll(`.form-tab-panel[data-form="${formName}"]`).forEach(p => p.classList.toggle("active", p.dataset.panel === target));
}

if (currentEditing) { renderReviseForm(main, record); return; }
const user = currentUser;
const canFinanceAct = user.role === "finance" && record.status === "pending_finance";
const canManagerAct = user.role === "manager" && record.status === "pending_manager";
const canAct = canFinanceAct || canManagerAct;
const canEdit = record.department === user.department && user.role !== "manager" && record.status !== "approved";
const lastReturnNote = record.status === "returned" ? [...record.history].reverse().find(h => h.action === "Returned for revision") : null;
main.innerHTML = `

</div>
<div class="detail-grid">
<div class="detail-main">
<div class="detail-title-row"><span class="type-chip">${escapeHtml(record.type)}</span><h1>${escapeHtml(record.title)}</h1></div>
<div class="meta-row">
<span>${deptGlyph(record.department)} ${escapeHtml(record.departmentLabel)}</span>
<span>Filed by ${escapeHtml(record.requestedBy)}</span>
<span>${fmtDate(record.createdAt)}</span>
${record.amount ? `<span class="mono">Amount: ${fmtMoney(record.amount)}</span>` : ""}
</div>
${lastReturnNote ? `
<div class="return-callout">⚠️<div>
<div class="return-callout-title">Finance returned this request</div>
<div class="return-callout-note">"${escapeHtml(lastReturnNote.note)}"</div>
</div></div>` : ""}
${canEdit ? `
<div style="display:flex; gap:10px; margin-top:14px;">
<button class="btn-primary" data-action="edit-toggle">${record.status === "returned" ? "Revise &amp; Resubmit" : "Edit Requisition"}</button>
<button class="btn-danger" data-action="delete-requisition">🗑 Delete</button>
</div>` : ""}
<h3 class="section-label">Description</h3>
<p class="description-text">${escapeHtml(record.description)}</p>
<h3 class="section-label">Quotations (${record.quotations.length}/3)</h3>
${record.quotations.length === 0 ? `<p class="hint">No quotations were attached to this request.</p>` : `
<div class="quote-grid">
${record.quotations.map(q => `
<a class="quote-file quote-file-link" href="${q.dataUrl}" download="${escapeHtml(q.name)}" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
📎<span class="quote-file-name">${escapeHtml(q.name)}</span><span class="quote-file-size">${(q.size / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB</span>
</a>`).join("")}
</div>`}
${canAct ? `
<div class="decision-box">

placeholder="${canFinanceAct ? "Note for the record (required if returning the request)…" : "Optional note for the record…"}"></textarea>
<div class="form-error" id="decision-error"></div>
<div class="decision-actions">
<button class="btn-danger" data-action="act-reject">✕ Reject</button>
${canFinanceAct ? `<button class="btn-return" data-action="act-return">↺ Return with Notes</button>` : ""}
<button class="btn-approve" data-action="act-approve">✓ ${record.status === "pending_manager" ? "Give Final Approval" : "Approve & Forward"}</button>
</div>
</div>` : ""}
</div>
<div class="detail-side">
<h3 class="section-label">Timeline</h3>

${record.history.map(h => `
<li><span class="tl-icon">🕒</span><div>

<div class="timeline-meta">${escapeHtml(h.actor)} · ${fmtDate(h.ts)}</div>

</div></li>`).join("")}
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>`;
}
